closures: MCV files use a payload followed by a monotonic uint32 offset table and a 16-byte footer containing two reserved zero words, payload length, and a packed entry-count/version word.
All supplied WCC MCV containers use format version 1 and satisfy payload_length + (declared_entry_count + 1)*4 + 16 == file_size.
MSG files are ASCII source catalogs containing LEVEL directives and typed configuration declarations; they are source inputs rather than opaque binary message containers.
The three 4000-byte BIN files are 80x25 text-mode screen images encoded as 2000 little-endian character/attribute cells.
STO, HSE, and the supplied SYS payloads are ASCII text artifacts and must not be decoded as opaque binary records.
unknowns: Semantic meaning of every MCV index entry requires correlation with the catalog compiler/consumer.
Exact CP437 palette interpretation of attribute bits follows the host terminal mode and remains host-owned.
DMA SYS authorization/token generation behavior remains unclaimed despite its text record grammar.
